name: cartesian-translation-contract
description: Generated-output semantic case. The evaluator checks a pure function-like contract without relying on rendered imagery.
prompt: Create a helper that translates every Cesium Cartesian3-like point exactly 10 units in the positive X direction and returns new points without mutating the input points.

checks.description: Candidate completes without captured console/runtime errors
Returned points are translated exactly +10 along Cartesian X
The generated helper does not mutate the input points

notes: This covers the review request for unit-test-like deterministic checks of generated output semantics.
